description: Database, schema/table, PostgreSQL load, container resources, Docker engine storage, and authoritative host-volume capacity telemetry.

options.content:
## Storage growth decisions
**Physical free space is the capacity authority.** Database/relation bytes explain part of that use; never add them to filesystem used bytes. Retained migration copies are not reclaimable space until explicitly retired.

Native SSD/HDD panels below compare two fresh **2-minute windows, 24 hours apart**, matched by resource, filesystem UUID, device and size. They show net physical growth and a linear planning estimate to the existing **85% usage alert**, not the storage policy reserve or permission to run maintenance. Negative projected days mean the threshold is already exceeded. Flat/falling growth, missing UUID/history or unhealthy telemetry produces no runway estimate—not infinite capacity. Shared-device resources must not be added together.

Database snapshots: **5-minute cadence / 30-day retention**. Filesystem telemetry: **15-second cadence / 7-day Loki retention**. Top relations include indexes and TOAST; sizes and row estimates do not establish compression, reclaimability or future growth.

Existing alerts: **70% warning / 85% critical / 92% emergency**, plus missing/failed physical telemetry. They notify only. Use the storage capacity plan before changing placement, retention or hardware.

**Shared storage metrics:** the dedicated datasource is disabled until explicitly configured with approved restricted access. Datasource-not-found or a query error means **unconfigured/unavailable**, never zero. The status table shows the shared contract's ready/partial/stale/unavailable reasons. Backlog/verified/oldest-day are CURRENT; trends use the selected UTC range (maximum 30 days / 720 buckets). Larger ranges fail visibly. Archived compressed, first-verified compressed and reclaimed physical bytes have different bases; they are not a net-growth equation. Legacy relation/insert/WAL/filesystem diagnostics retain their own datasource and labels.

targets.expr: ((max by (resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | physical_host_visible="true" | filesystem_uuid!="" | keep resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes, available_bytes | unwrap available_bytes | __error__="" [2m] offset 24h)) - max by (resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | physical_host_visible="true" | filesystem_uuid!="" | keep resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes, available_bytes | unwrap available_bytes | __error__="" [2m])))) and on (resource_id) (min by (resource_id) (min_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="storage_health" | physical_host_visible="true" | keep resource_id, available | unwrap available | __error__="" [2m])) > 0)

panels.title: Native storage: 24h net growth
panels.description: Net loss of physical available bytes between fresh endpoint windows 24h apart, including all users of that filesystem. Negative means net space gained; this is not a sustained growth guarantee.

targets.expr: ((0.85 * (max by (resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | physical_host_visible="true" | filesystem_uuid!="" | keep resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes, available_bytes | unwrap available_bytes | __error__="" [2m])) + max by (resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | physical_host_visible="true" | filesystem_uuid!="" | keep resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes, used_bytes | unwrap used_bytes | __error__="" [2m]))) - max by (resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | physical_host_visible="true" | filesystem_uuid!="" | keep resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes, used_bytes | unwrap used_bytes | __error__="" [2m]))) / ((max by (resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | physical_host_visible="true" | filesystem_uuid!="" | keep resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes, available_bytes | unwrap available_bytes | __error__="" [2m] offset 24h)) - max by (resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | physical_host_visible="true" | filesystem_uuid!="" | keep resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes, available_bytes | unwrap available_bytes | __error__="" [2m]))) > 0)) and on (resource_id) (min by (resource_id) (min_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="storage_health" | physical_host_visible="true" | keep resource_id, available | unwrap available | __error__="" [2m])) > 0)

panels.title: Native storage: days to 85% used
panels.description: Linear planning estimate to the existing 85% usage alert from positive 24h physical growth. Negative means already above the threshold. Missing, flat or falling growth is not infinite runway. This is not the policy reserve, a two-year forecast, or maintenance admission.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' - max(sampled_at)))::double precision AS value FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples;

panels.title: Database capacity sample age
panels.description: Age of the latest database sample, independent of the selected historical range. Expected cadence is 300 seconds. Color bands show two/three missed cadences, not a storage capacity decision.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, CASE WHEN state = 'ready' AND complete AND NOT truncated THEN value END AS value FROM observability_metrics.storage_series_v1('database_allocated_bytes', to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), CASE WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 216000000 THEN 300 WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 1296000000 THEN 1800 ELSE 7200 END) ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Selected UTC half-open range. Shared versioned allocated bytes, not filesystem used or reclaimable bytes. Partial, missing or stale buckets are null. See Shared storage metric status.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, CASE WHEN state = 'ready' AND complete AND NOT truncated THEN value / 86400.0 END AS value FROM observability_metrics.storage_growth_v1('database_allocated_bytes', to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), CASE WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 216000000 THEN 300 WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 1296000000 THEN 1800 ELSE 7200 END) ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Database net allocated growth / second
panels.description: Shared versioned adjacent-bucket allocated-size change, converted from bytes/day to bytes/second for display. Previous missing or partial buckets remain null. This is not archive throughput or physical filesystem growth.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, CASE WHEN state = 'ready' AND complete AND NOT truncated THEN value END AS value FROM observability_metrics.storage_series_v1('market_allocated_bytes', to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), CASE WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 216000000 THEN 300 WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 1296000000 THEN 1800 ELSE 7200 END) ORDER BY time;

panels.description: Selected UTC half-open range. Shared versioned allocated bytes, not filesystem used or reclaimable bytes. Partial, missing or stale buckets are null. See Shared storage metric status.

panels.description: Selected UTC half-open range. Shared versioned allocated bytes, not filesystem used or reclaimable bytes. Partial, missing or stale buckets are null. See Shared storage metric status.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sampled_at AS time,schema_name||'.'||relation_name AS metric,total_bytes::double precision AS value FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) AND schema_name ~ '${schema:regex}' AND relation_name ~ '${relation:regex}' ORDER BY sampled_at;

SELECT sampled_at AS time,schema_name||'.'||relation_name AS metric,estimated_live_rows::double precision AS value FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) AND schema_name ~ '${schema:regex}' AND relation_name ~ '${relation:regex}' ORDER BY sampled_at;

WITH l AS (SELECT max(sampled_at) sampled_at FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at)) SELECT s.schema_name,s.relation_name,s.relation_kind,pg_size_pretty(s.total_bytes) total,pg_size_pretty(s.table_bytes) table_data,pg_size_pretty(s.index_bytes) indexes,pg_size_pretty(s.toast_bytes) toast,s.estimated_live_rows,s.estimated_dead_rows FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples s JOIN l USING(sampled_at) WHERE s.schema_name ~ '${schema:regex}' AND s.relation_name ~ '${relation:regex}' ORDER BY s.total_bytes DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Largest logical relations now
panels.description: Total includes table, indexes and TOAST. Estimated rows are not exact bytes-per-Fact measurements; retained migration namespaces are not automatically reclaimable.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT * FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) AND schema_name ~ '${schema:regex}' AND relation_name ~ '${relation:regex}'), f AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON(schema_name,relation_name) schema_name,relation_name,sampled_at,total_bytes,estimated_live_rows FROM s ORDER BY schema_name,relation_name,sampled_at), l AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON(schema_name,relation_name) schema_name,relation_name,sampled_at,total_bytes,estimated_live_rows FROM s ORDER BY schema_name,relation_name,sampled_at DESC) SELECT l.schema_name,l.relation_name,pg_size_pretty(l.total_bytes) current_size,pg_size_pretty(l.total_bytes-f.total_bytes) growth,l.estimated_live_rows-f.estimated_live_rows row_growth,ROUND(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(l.sampled_at-f.sampled_at))>0 THEN (l.total_bytes-f.total_bytes)::numeric/EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(l.sampled_at-f.sampled_at)) ELSE NULL END,2) bytes_per_second FROM l JOIN f USING(schema_name,relation_name) ORDER BY l.total_bytes-f.total_bytes DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Relation growth over selected range
panels.description: Dedicated sampled relation diagnostic, not a canonical archive/reclamation flow or filesystem growth. Schema/relation filters apply here and to legacy diagnostics.

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT sampled_at,schema_name,relation_name,inserts_total,lag(sampled_at) OVER(PARTITION BY schema_name,relation_name ORDER BY sampled_at) previous_at,lag(inserts_total) OVER(PARTITION BY schema_name,relation_name ORDER BY sampled_at) previous_inserts FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) AND schema_name ~ '${schema:regex}' AND relation_name ~ '${relation:regex}') SELECT sampled_at AS time,schema_name||'.'||relation_name AS metric,CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(sampled_at-previous_at))>0 THEN GREATEST(inserts_total-previous_inserts,0)::double precision/EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(sampled_at-previous_at)) ELSE 0 END value FROM p WHERE previous_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sampled_at;

WITH p AS (SELECT sampled_at,wal_bytes,lag(sampled_at) OVER(ORDER BY sampled_at) previous_at,lag(wal_bytes) OVER(ORDER BY sampled_at) previous_bytes FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at)) SELECT sampled_at AS time,CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(sampled_at-previous_at))>0 THEN GREATEST(wal_bytes-previous_bytes,0)::double precision/EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(sampled_at-previous_at)) ELSE 0 END value FROM p WHERE previous_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sampled_at;

SELECT sampled_at AS time,connections_total::double precision AS total,connections_active::double precision AS active,connections_idle::double precision AS idle,max_connections::double precision AS maximum FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) ORDER BY sampled_at;

SELECT sampled_at AS time,CASE WHEN blocks_hit+blocks_read>0 THEN 100.0*blocks_hit::double precision/(blocks_hit+blocks_read) ELSE 100.0 END value FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) ORDER BY sampled_at;

targets.expr: avg_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="container" | container_name=~"${container:regex}" | unwrap cpu_percent [$__interval]) by (container_name)
avg_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="container" | container_name=~"${container:regex}" | unwrap memory_percent [$__interval]) by (container_name)
max by (resource_id) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | keep resource_id, used_bytes | unwrap used_bytes | __error__="" [2m]))
max by (resource_id) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | keep resource_id, available_bytes | unwrap available_bytes | __error__="" [2m]))
max by (resource_id) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | keep resource_id, total_bytes | unwrap total_bytes | __error__="" [2m]))

targets.rawSql: SELECT sampled_at AS time,sample_query_ms::double precision AS value FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) ORDER BY sampled_at;
SELECT sampled_at AS time,relation_count::double precision AS value FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) ORDER BY sampled_at;

panels.title: Windows Docker Desktop: days to host reserve
panels.description: Windows-only host-capacity sampler projection; not the native server SSD/HDD forecast.

targets.expr: {compose_service=~"docker-stats|host-capacity"} | json | sample_kind=~"filesystem|host_filesystem|capacity_unavailable|host_capacity_unavailable" | line_format "{{.sample_kind}} scope={{.capacity_scope}} authority={{.capacity_authority}} physical_host_visible={{.physical_host_visible}} runtime={{.runtime_kind}} resource={{.resource_id}} reason={{.reason}}"

panels.title: Canonical backlog: current eligible physical bytes
panels.description: CURRENT bounded metadata, independent of the selected history range. Source physical bytes are not compressed archive bytes or deletion permission. Unknown/open/unsealed/capped inputs remain unavailable or partial. See Shared storage metric status.

targets.rawSql: SELECT current_timestamp AS time, CASE WHEN state = 'ready' AND complete AND NOT truncated THEN value END AS value, metric_id || ' [' || state || ': ' || reason || ']' AS metric FROM observability_metrics.storage_metric_status_v1() WHERE metric_id = 'eligible_backlog_physical_bytes';

panels.title: Current verified source awaiting fresh reclaim guards
panels.description: CURRENT bounded metadata, independent of the selected history range. Source physical bytes are not compressed archive bytes or deletion permission. Unknown/open/unsealed/capped inputs remain unavailable or partial. See Shared storage metric status.

targets.rawSql: SELECT current_timestamp AS time, CASE WHEN state = 'ready' AND complete AND NOT truncated THEN value END AS value, metric_id || ' [' || state || ': ' || reason || ']' AS metric FROM observability_metrics.storage_metric_status_v1() WHERE metric_id = 'verified_guarded_physical_bytes';

panels.title: Canonical lifecycle: unique completed bytes by basis
panels.description: Selected UTC half-open range. Unique completion bytes in occupied buckets: archived compressed, first verified compressed, reclaimed physical hot. These bases cannot be subtracted as net physical growth. Empty/incomplete buckets are null, never proof of zero. No attempts or repeated verification counts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, CASE WHEN state = 'ready' AND complete AND NOT truncated THEN value END AS value, 'Archived compressed bytes' AS metric FROM observability_metrics.storage_series_v1('archive_compressed_bytes', to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), CASE WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 216000000 THEN 300 WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 1296000000 THEN 1800 ELSE 7200 END) UNION ALL SELECT time, CASE WHEN state = 'ready' AND complete AND NOT truncated THEN value END AS value, 'First verified compressed bytes' AS metric FROM observability_metrics.storage_series_v1('verified_first_compressed_bytes', to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), CASE WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 216000000 THEN 300 WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 1296000000 THEN 1800 ELSE 7200 END) UNION ALL SELECT time, CASE WHEN state = 'ready' AND complete AND NOT truncated THEN value END AS value, 'Reclaimed physical hot bytes' AS metric FROM observability_metrics.storage_series_v1('reclaimed_physical_hot_bytes', to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), CASE WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 216000000 THEN 300 WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 1296000000 THEN 1800 ELSE 7200 END) ORDER BY time, metric;

panels.title: Current oldest eligible storage day
panels.description: CURRENT projection, not historical. Oldest day follows the applied policy and bounded eligible set. Partial/unknown inputs retain their reason. A known oldest day is not proof of reclaimable bytes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT metric_id, CASE WHEN state = 'ready' AND complete AND NOT truncated THEN oldest_day END AS oldest_day, state, reason, complete, truncated, basis FROM observability_metrics.storage_metric_status_v1() ORDER BY metric_id;

panels.title: Shared storage metric status
panels.description: Shared SQL readiness and incompleteness beside the numbers. Datasource-not-found/query error means configuration/unavailable, never a successful empty metric. Production access needs approved restricted credentials and verified pooled-session deadlines before metadata statements.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'current'::text AS scope, metric_id, state, reason, complete, truncated FROM observability_metrics.storage_metric_status_v1() UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'selected range'::text AS scope, 'database_allocated_bytes'::text AS metric_id, state, reason, complete, truncated FROM observability_metrics.storage_series_v1('database_allocated_bytes', to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), CASE WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 216000000 THEN 300 WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 1296000000 THEN 1800 ELSE 7200 END) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'selected range'::text AS scope, 'market_allocated_bytes'::text AS metric_id, state, reason, complete, truncated FROM observability_metrics.storage_series_v1('market_allocated_bytes', to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), CASE WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 216000000 THEN 300 WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 1296000000 THEN 1800 ELSE 7200 END) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'selected range'::text AS scope, 'archive_compressed_bytes'::text AS metric_id, state, reason, complete, truncated FROM observability_metrics.storage_series_v1('archive_compressed_bytes', to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), CASE WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 216000000 THEN 300 WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 1296000000 THEN 1800 ELSE 7200 END) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'selected range'::text AS scope, 'verified_first_compressed_bytes'::text AS metric_id, state, reason, complete, truncated FROM observability_metrics.storage_series_v1('verified_first_compressed_bytes', to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), CASE WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 216000000 THEN 300 WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 1296000000 THEN 1800 ELSE 7200 END) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'selected range'::text AS scope, 'reclaimed_physical_hot_bytes'::text AS metric_id, state, reason, complete, truncated FROM observability_metrics.storage_series_v1('reclaimed_physical_hot_bytes', to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), CASE WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 216000000 THEN 300 WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 1296000000 THEN 1800 ELSE 7200 END) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'selected range'::text AS scope, 'database_growth_bytes_per_day'::text AS metric_id, state, reason, complete, truncated FROM observability_metrics.storage_growth_v1('database_allocated_bytes', to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), CASE WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 216000000 THEN 300 WHEN (${__to}-${__from}) <= 1296000000 THEN 1800 ELSE 7200 END) ORDER BY scope, metric_id, state, reason;

list.definition: SELECT '.*' AS __text,'.*' AS __value UNION SELECT DISTINCT schema_name AS __text,schema_name AS __value FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples ORDER BY 1;
